title: Sean Payton on the signing of safety Taylor Rapp: ‘It was more availability than necessity’

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Sean Payton on the signing of safety Taylor Rapp: ‘It was more availability than necessity’
sources.description: The Broncos announced that they signed veteran safety Taylor Rapp last week ahead of their Week 2 preseason matchup vs. the Green Bay Packers to add some depth to their safety room.
